name: @austinm911/anti-slop
description: GitHub source registry of structural ast-grep and Oxlint rules

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run rules:test && bun run discovery:typecheck && bun run discovery:test && bun run registry:check
scripts.rules:test: ast-grep test --config ast-grep/sgconfig.yml --skip-snapshot-tests && ast-grep test --config ast-grep/sgconfig.preferences.yml --skip-snapshot-tests && node oxlint/test.mjs
